newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa heart surgeon Barnard to be dad at 74.
newsitem.headline: South Africa heart surgeon Barnard to be dad at 74.

text.p: South African heart transplant pioneer Christiaan Barnard is to become a father for the sixth time at the age of 74, the Afrikaans-language newspaper Die Burger said on Wednesday.
It quoted Barnard's third wife, 32-year-old Karin, as saying their second baby is due in March.
"We are very excited...The baby was planned," she told the newspaper.
Barnard made history on December 3, 1967, when he performed the world's first human heart transplant in Cape Town, where he and his wife now live.
In recent years he has been involved in research on anti-ageing medications.
